findings:
set -eu
repo=$1 dir=$2 ticket=$3 run=$4 attempt=$5 tools=$6 base=$7
index="$dir/change.index"
rm -f "$index"
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$index" git -C "$repo" read-tree HEAD
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$index" git -C "$repo" add -A -- . ':(exclude)findings'
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$index" git -C "$repo" diff --cached "$base" -- . ':(exclude)findings' > "$dir/change.diff"
rm -f "$index"
set -- "$repo"/findings/*.json
[ -e "$1" ] || { echo "no critic findings under $repo/findings" >&2; exit 1; }
exec "$tools/gold-band-findings" check --run-id "$run" --attempt "$attempt" --diff "$dir/change.diff" --ticket "$ticket" --report-dir "$dir" "$@"
